basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Deputy CTO | Hands-On Technical Leadership | Architecture, Delivery & Team Ownership
basics.summary: Hands-on technical leader who still ships code: as Tech Lead at Beekeeper I owned architecture end-to-end, acted as hiring manager for AI roles, and translated business problems (a $337K vendor cost, a stalled onboarding funnel) into working systems within weeks. I operate across the full spread of a CTO's job: architecture, delivery, infrastructure, and the operational work, without treating any of it as beneath me. Currently embedded at LumApps, I own AI transformation end-to-end and report outcomes directly to C-level, the same cross-functional trust this role needs. 13+ years of production engineering in Java, Python, and TypeScript, plus an MBA, so I move naturally between technical decisions and business ones.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing, tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, a query and write-back contract per agent, and a freshness layer that flags stale facts, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort as acting hiring manager for AI roles: defined the bar, ran the process, closed candidates, and grew engineers who now lead features independently.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks, turning a business cost problem into a working technical system. 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting. Infrastructure work, treated as core, not an afterthought.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Built cloud infrastructure and DevOps pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Deputy CTO at Social Discovery Group (SDG), a remote-first group of social discovery/entertainment platforms. Acts as the CTO's second-in-command across backend and ML teams; owns architecture and technical decisions end-to-end; stays hands-on shipping code; translates business problems into technical solutions for a 5-10 person team; leads people (hiring, offboarding, compensation, resourcing); owns cross-team alignment at CTO/CDO level; manages infrastructure and operational work without treating it as beneath the role; operates in a constantly shifting priority environment. Requires: strong backend background (C#/Python preferred, Java or other backend also welcome), genuinely hands-on, solid business understanding, real people-management experience, comfort across architecture/delivery/infrastructure/operations, startup mindset, 8+ years senior experience including hands-on development and a technical leadership/management role. Fully remote.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: hands-on architecture ownership (Employee Referral, AI Brain), real hiring experience (acting hiring manager for AI roles at Beekeeper), infrastructure/on-call ownership (Grafana/Datadog/Logz.io, Dronistics DevOps from scratch), business-to-technical translation (LLM pipeline replacing a $337K vendor cost), MBA for business fluency, Java/Python/TypeScript backend depth (no C# documented, but JD explicitly welcomes other backend languages). No documented compensation/offboarding decision-making or explicit CTO/CDO-level peer negotiation; framed the hiring and cross-functional reporting facts honestly without inflating scope.
